checks.flagship_security_intent: Define and assign Intune compliance policies so unhealthy devices are flagged and gated from work data.
Enroll licensed devices into Intune so cloud identity and compliance controls reach every endpoint.
Cover managed devices with antivirus, firewall, disk-encryption, and ASR endpoint-security policies.
Configure and assign attack surface reduction rules to block ransomware and fileless malware behaviors.
Configure and assign a BitLocker disk-encryption policy so lost or stolen devices do not leak data.
Configure, assign, and prove tamper protection enabled so malware cannot silently disable Defender.
Enable DKIM signing for every accepted domain so unsigned mail is not trusted or spoofed.
Set every domain's DMARC policy to reject so spoofed mail cannot reach inboxes.
Keep mailbox auditing enabled organization-wide so illicit mailbox access is investigable.
Disable SMTP AUTH organization-wide so basic-auth email submission cannot bypass modern sign-in protections.
Complete the authentication methods policy migration so MFA and SSPR settings live in one place.
Maintain documented break-glass emergency accounts and justify every Conditional Access exclusion.
Block sign-ins marked high risk by Identity Protection via Conditional Access.
Block legacy authentication clients tenant-wide so outdated sign-in methods cannot bypass modern MFA.
Require compliant or hybrid-joined managed devices for cloud app access via Conditional Access.
Require multi-factor authentication for every user via Conditional Access to prevent password-only sign-in.
Require phishing-resistant MFA for all users via Conditional Access to defeat phishing of ordinary MFA methods.
Require phishing-resistant MFA for highly privileged directory roles via Conditional Access.
Gate privileged sign-ins with phishing-resistant MFA and block legacy authentication via Conditional Access.
Protect workload identities (service principals) with risk-based Conditional Access policies.
Disable or move to just-in-time access any privileged accounts that sit unused and become takeover targets.
Enforce Identity Protection user-risk and sign-in-risk policies so risky logins are blocked.
Require Microsoft Authenticator number matching to defeat MFA-fatigue and push-bombing attacks.
Require justification, an authentication context, and a short time limit for privileged-role activation.
Remove permanent active assignments for highly privileged roles in favor of just-in-time PIM access.
Operationalize privileged access through PIM activation with MFA instead of standing permanent roles.
Keep highly privileged accounts cloud-only and separate from on-premises directories.
Onboard licensed devices to Defender for Endpoint so EDR coverage and license value are realized.
Enforce Safe Attachments and Safe Links in block mode for all recipients to stop phishing and malware.
Assign a default sensitivity label and require labeling so unlabeled sensitive content does not leak.
Enforce Purview DLP policies in production so sensitive data cannot leak through mail, files, or endpoints.
Publish sensitivity labels through an enabled label policy so classification and protection reach users.
Run enabled Sentinel scheduled analytics rules so SIEM spend produces detection yield.
Connect high-value data sources to Sentinel so the security workspace has real signals to correlate.
